acceptance: HUMAN_INPUT: science; proposed bands are not accepted or earned

tests.field: 3D smooth rectangular no-slip developed Poiseuille profile; analytic pressure from odd-mode series in rectangular_pressure_pa
tests.boundary: exact developed inlet, known outlet p datum; use fully developed segment, not an entrance-flow comparison
tests.recommendation: relative pressure <=1%, velocity L2 order 2 in [1.5,2.5]; accepted nonzero absolute floor required

tests.boundary: exact U and compatible p gauge/traction; retain mass residual
tests.recommendation: U,p L2 observed order 2, proposed [1.5,2.5]; source adapter inside pinned image, no turbulence closure claimed

tests.boundary: exact manufactured c, normal total solute flux; no clipping
tests.recommendation: volume-weighted c L2 order 2, proposed [1.5,2.5]; limiter/mesh must actually reach asymptotic regime

tests.field: uniform c=0.5, zero variance and M=1
tests.observable: independent advective+diffusive solute and volume balance; zero-diffusive gradients
tests.recommendation: HUMAN_INPUT absolute concentration/flux floors; checks conservation, not mixing ability

tests.field: two unmixed c=0/1 inlet streams, D=0 diagnostic outside P, and maximum-Pe supported D=0.5e-10 at Q=5
tests.observable: raw flux-weighted variance/M at finite outlet; independent mesh and scalar scheme refinement; no periodic concentration reset
tests.recommendation: HUMAN_INPUT zero-D artificial-mixing band; packet supported-D delta-M<=0.02 and delta-pressure<=5% are not accepted near-band widths

tests.field: fresh same-input flow/scalar pair versus retained U,p,phi; repeat complete mesh/observer
tests.observable: raw fields and decision observables agree at approved numerical band; wrong mesh/Q/image/phi refused
tests.recommendation: HUMAN_INPUT accepted numerical/decision tolerances, repeat after image or scheme repin

tests.field: matched COMSOL public micromixer/transport benchmarks + independent full-task non-hidden draw or retired public cases
tests.observable: pointwise M/pressure/residence AND per-design feasibility/pick/regret; conserve raw fields and custody
tests.recommendation: HUMAN_INPUT recommendation abs M<=0.02, pressure/residence<=5% with absolute floors; no reality/assay claim

failure_policy: Reference inadequacy, backflow-inapplicable observer and infrastructure failures remain distinct; no candidate penalty or NONE_FEASIBLE invented. Systematic witness disagreement versions future references, never silently rescores sealed results.
